description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the LocationService in the OrangeHRM system, testing various methods such as getLocationById, searchLocations, and others with mock dependencies.

classes.name: LocationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the LocationService class methods, including getLocationById, searchLocations, and others with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating the LocationService instance, setting fixture data, and mocking dependencies.

methods.name: testGetLocationById
methods.description: Tests the getLocationById method of LocationService, ensuring it returns the correct Location object.

methods.name: testSearchLocations
methods.description: Tests the searchLocations method of LocationService, verifying it returns a list of Location objects based on search filters.

methods.name: testGetSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Verifies that getSearchLocationListCount returns the correct count for given search parameters.

methods.name: testGetNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Checks if getNumberOfEmployeesForLocation correctly returns the number of employees for a specified location.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Ensures getLocationIdsForEmployees returns the correct list of location IDs for a list of employee numbers.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleLocationsArray
methods.description: Tests the getAccessibleLocationsArray method with and without a location ID parameter, expecting an empty array in these tests.
